messages.subject: At "save file" nothing happens
parts:
Hello! I have a very simple function - it takes the original input data frame and multiplies it by 10. I want to build a Shiny app around it.

This is how I generated my input data frame and saved it in my working directory (outside Shiny):

df <- data.frame(a = 1:2, b = 2:3)
write.csv(df, "my data frame.csv", row.names = F)

I want the app user to be able to read in an input data frame (in this case - "my data frame.csv"), run the function and then download the results as a .csv file. Everything is working except:
1. When the user clicks on the button "Save Results" the suggest file name appears with quotation marks: "My Results.csv"
2. When I try to save it (with quotation marks or without), NOTHING gets saved. 

Your help is greatly appreciated - I don't understand why the output data frame is not getting saved.


My ui.r code:

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
      headerPanel("My Shiny Page"),
      
      # Sidebar with controls to select the input data frame and then download the resulting data frame:
      sidebarPanel(

            # Data input:
            fileInput('datafile','Select your file:'),
            
            # Data output:
            textInput("getresults", "Download your results:"),
            downloadButton('getresults', "Save Results")
            
      ),
      
      mainPanel(
            tabPanel("MaxDiff Scores",
                     verbatimTextOutput("raw"),
                     value = 1)
      )
))


My server.r code (btw - if you see something clunky, unelegant, unnecessary, stupid, please comment!):

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
      
      # Drop-down selection box for which data set to use:
      renderUI({
            fileInput("datafile", "Choose Your Input File:")
      })
      
      mydata <- reactive({
            inFile <- input$datafile
            if(is.null(inFile))
                  return(NULL)
            df.raw <- read.csv(inFile$datapath)
            info <- list(df.raw = df.raw)
            return(info)
      })
      
      mymain <- reactive({
            
            mydata <- input$data
            # Actual calculations - multiply my data frame by 10:
            out <- mydata()$df.raw * 10
            return( list(output = out) )
      })
      
      # Showing the transformed data frame in the main tab:
      output$raw<-renderPrint({
            if(is.null(input$datafile)){return()}
            outtab <- mymain()$output 
            return(outtab)
      })
      
      # Ensuring the user can save (download) the transformed data frame:
      output$getresults <- downloadHandler(
            filename = "My Results.csv",
            content = function(file) {
                  write.csv(mymain()$output, file, row.names = F)
            }
      )
      
})
